digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler binding store and create dispatch
propositions: Under DC index lag, a crashed create_issue call leaves a keyless-pending binding entry while the unindexed issue exists in Jira but is not yet searchable, causing recover_pending to unbind on a single negative search and create_one to then write a duplicate issue via its own search miss.

The deduplication gate in create_one at dispatch_one.py:237-238 relies solely on get_jira_key(local_id) being None, which is true for keyless-pending entries, so leaving the entry pending without gating the create at the write site does not prevent the duplicate.

recover_pending's keyless branch must record search misses and unbind only when search_miss_count >= 3 AND entry age exceeds a configurable grace period (default 3600s per JIRASERVER-70423), converting a silent duplicate into a delayed-but-correct answer.

create_one must defer (not drop) the create while a keyless-pending binding for that local_id exists and is younger than the grace period, consulting a new is_keyless_pending_within_grace accessor that the pending entry state alone cannot satisfy.
recover_pending must not count still-pending entries as resolved in its return value, preserving the distinction between entries that were settled and those deferred awaiting index convergence.

This fix applies uniformly to both Cloud and DC since both have eventual-consistent indexes; the narrower window on Cloud means creates are deferred less frequently in the rare crash path rather than not at all.
